_comment: Superset example config. Spec 4.0 / component_spec_version 3.0. Aggregates every component_class and control pattern observed across festo-dev-applied-motion, festo-dev-fluid-control, and festo-dev-gripper into one illustrative config.

gantry_1._comment: FPosBAPI backend. Targets a CECC-X PLC running the FPosBAPI CoDeSys server.

gantry_2._comment: Modbus backend, 4-axis gantry (X/Y/ZP/ZG) carrying a pipettor and a gripper tool.

controller_1._comment: CECC-X CODESYS PLC, same physical unit as gantry_1. No CPX-E IO module attached

controller_2._comment: CPX-E-EP remote-IO fieldbus node driving the gripper, switch, and sensor.

sensor_1._comment: Optical switch sensor on controller_2's IO-Link module.

gripper_1._comment: Digital parallel gripper mounted on gantry_2's ZG axis for automated tool changes.

gripper_2._comment: Standalone IO-Link pneumatic gripper, pressure-channel controlled via CPX-AP. No mount point (topological only).

dispenser_1._comment: Macro dispenser. Regulator-type pressure module (VEAB via gantry client), mounted on gantry_1's Z axis.
